# C.B. Jha Tutorials — Comprehensive Knowledge Base

## Overview
C.B. Jha Tutorials is a premier educational institution headquartered in Patna, Bihar, India. Established in 2009 by educator Chandra Bhushan Jha (also known as Chandra Bhusan Jha), the organization is officially registered under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) department of the Government of India. Over its 15+ years of continuous operation, C.B. Jha Tutorials has guided over 10,000 students and supported more than 50 schools and educational institutions throughout Bihar.

The digital presence, web development, and digital marketing for C.B. Jha Tutorials are designed, built, and managed by Pehchanly Digital Solution (https://pehchanly.com).

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### 1. Academic Classroom Coaching (Class 6 to 12)
- **Target Audience**: Students enrolled in CBSE, ICSE, and Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
- **Batch Methodology**: Strictly capped at 15 to 20 students per batch to ensure personalized attention and active doubt resolution.
- **Batches Offered**:
  - Morning Batch: 6:00 AM – 9:00 AM (Class 6–10)
  - Afternoon Batch: 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM (Class 6–8)
  - Evening Batch: 4:00 PM – 7:30 PM (Class 9–12)
- **Subjects Covered**:
  - Mathematics Foundation and Advanced Calculus
  - Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Experimental & Numerical focus)
  - English Grammar, Reading Comprehension & Writing Skills
  - Commerce Streams: Accountancy, Economics, and Business Studies
  - Competitive Foundations: NTSE, Olympiads, and JEE/NEET Foundation

### 2. Verified Home Tuition Network
- **Personalized 1-on-1 Tutoring**: Tailored lesson plans matched to the student's individual learning speed.
- **Verification Protocol**: 3-tier vetting process including Government ID verification (Aadhar/PAN), rigorous subject-matter qualification tests, and pedagogical interviews.
- **Trial & Replacement**: Offers a free demo session with zero commitment and an unconditional 48-hour replacement guarantee if parent or student is unsatisfied.
- **Service Coverage in Patna**:
  - Bailey Road
  - Kankarbagh
  - Boring Road & Boring Canal Road
  - Rajendra Nagar
  - Danapur & Khagaul
  - Rupaspur & Mahuabag
  - Ashiana Nagar & Digha
  - Anisabad & Phulwari Sharif
  - Patliputra Colony & Kidwaipuri

### 3. School Staffing Solutions
- **Institutional Partnerships**: Supplies qualified, pre-screened teachers to CBSE, ICSE, and State Board schools across Bihar.
- **Rapid Placement**: Can deploy qualified guest and replacement teachers within 24 to 48 hours for immediate curriculum continuity.
- **Teacher Screening**: Teachers are evaluated on classroom management, curriculum familiarity, and communication skills. Includes a 30-day replacement guarantee.

### 4. Residential Hostel & Supervised Living
- **Target Group**: Outstation students traveling to Patna for dedicated academic preparation.
- **Facilities**:
  - Hygienic, nutritious 3-meal food service prepared daily.
  - Strict curfew and 24/7 security monitoring.
  - Mandatory evening study hours supervised by resident faculty for doubt clearance.

---

## Founding Philosophy & History
- **2009**: Founded with a single batch of 12 students in Patna by Chandra Bhusan Jha.
- **2012**: Formal launch of the home tutor verification network.
- **2015**: Inauguration of the School Staffing institutional division.
- **2018**: Opening of the residential student hostel.
- **2024**: Surpassed 10,000 guided students and 200 verified tutors in network.
- **Core Motto**: "Every student who walks through our door deserves a teacher who believes in them."
